whyItMatters: apex SQL is assembled from parts (Database.querys*([^)]*+), so untrusted input rewrites the statement.
actions: Rewrite the query with Database.queryWithBinds in user mode, binding every value as a parameter.
For dynamic identifiers, map input through an allowlist of columns and tables.
Re-run the scan and confirm no concatenated query remains on untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no concatenated query on untrusted input, and quote payloads stay inert data.
